title: 第2254章 做我的随从第2253章 跟你说一声谢谢
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: 褚绛雪站在莫凡身边，看着山谷内的风长卿，神色漠然，好像在看一个陌生人。
“绛雪，风宫主是生是死，由你来决定。”莫凡说道。
再怎么说，风长卿也是褚绛雪的父亲。
虽然风长卿囚禁褚绛雪，要把她强行许配给檀奕，对她的伤害很大，但莫凡不知道她有没有放下父女之间的那份血缘关系。
所以莫凡觉得还是由褚绛雪来做决定比较好。
褚绛雪静静地看了几眼风长卿。
风长卿脸上几分期待之色，心中也很不甘。
他希望褚绛雪能原谅他，给他留一条生路。
同时，他堂堂一个顶级主神，但他现在的生死，竟然由自己女儿的一句话决定，这让他很不甘，感觉很屈辱。
“莫凡，风长卿曾经是我的父亲，但是他不但囚禁我，还在我丹田上布置了一个阻止我自爆的禁制。从那时候开始，我就已经跟他断绝父女关系了。我现在跟他之间，就是一个陌路人。他的生死，还是由你来决定吧。”褚绛雪淡淡说道。
在飘渺神宫的时候，为了拒绝被檀奕带走，她曾经以自爆来求风长卿，让风长卿放她走。
但檀奕却告诉她，风长卿偷偷在她丹田上布置了一个禁制，她想自爆都自爆不了。
她只能活生生地被檀奕强行带走。
在那一刻，她心中充满绝望，对风长卿的恨意达到顶峰。
风长卿的所作所为，根本配不上父亲的身份。
也是在那个时候，她决定彻底断绝跟风长卿的父女关系。
他现在称呼风长卿，不再是爹或者父亲，而是直呼其名。
这就是在跟风长卿划清界限。
听到褚绛雪说出的那一番话，风长卿脸色苍白。
“绛雪，我……我错了。以前我是被檀落云胁迫，如果我不答应他，青虹剑宗就跟我们飘渺神宫断交，还会暗地里打压我们。青虹剑宗的实力比我们强，被他们打压的话，我们在神域的地位将会受到很大影响，所以……”风长卿小心翼翼地求情，声音有些颤抖干涩。
一个顶级主神，这样祈求别人的原谅，而且还是自己的女儿，风长卿感觉很丢脸。
但为了活命，他不得不忍着。
褚绛雪冷笑一声，“所以，你就能为了飘渺神宫，牺牲你的亲生女儿？”
“檀奕他……他也是一眼相中你，他会对你好，不亏待你的。跟他结为道侣，你就会得到更多的修炼资源，这对你来说也不是什么坏事。”风长卿辩解。
“呵呵，不会亏待我？风长卿你知不知道，檀奕只是把我当作一个玩物，他说玩我几个月玩腻了之后，就会把我送给赵荀川。他还说，我能成为赵荀川这个普通主神的玩物，对我来说也是一种莫大的荣幸吧。所以，你所谓的对我好，就是这种好法？”
“什么？檀奕真的这样说过？”风长卿难以置信。
他不敢相信，檀奕竟然说过这样的话，敢这样对待褚绛雪。
“哼！檀奕已经死了，我没必要说他坏话，只是在陈述事实。这样的人渣，说一句关于他的话我都嫌脏。另外，你也别想求我放过你。当初是你没放过我，不顾我的死活，现在我只是以其人之道还治其人之身。”
说到这里，褚绛雪不再看风长卿，而是伸手搂着莫凡的胳膊，脑袋轻轻靠在莫凡的肩膀上。
莫凡沉吟片刻，想到了一个办法。
“风长卿，我给你一个机会。一个活着的机会。”莫凡说道。
褚绛雪拉了拉莫凡的衣袖，低声说道：“莫凡，你不用给我面子。我刚才说了，我已经跟风长卿没有任何关系，他的死活，你决定就好。”
莫凡轻吻一下褚绛雪额头，“绛雪，我现在做这个决定，不是看你的面子，而是为了我们的安全。”
莫凡知道，虽然褚绛雪已经不认风长卿为父亲，但是让她开口让莫凡杀了风长卿，这对她来说有些残忍。
莫凡现在给风长卿一个机会，是为了不让褚绛雪为难。
content_en:
Chu Jiangxue stood next to Mo Fan and looked at Feng Changqing in the valley with an indifferent expression, as if she was looking at a stranger.
"Jiangxue, it's up to you to decide whether Lord Feng Palace lives or dies." Mo Fan said.
After all, Feng Changqing is also Chu Jiangxue's father.
Although Feng Changqing imprisoned Chu Jiangxue and forcibly betrothed her to Tan Yi, which was very harmful to her, Mo Fan didn't know if she had let go of the blood relationship between father and daughter.
Therefore, Mo Fan felt that it would be better for Chu Jiangxue to make the decision.
Chu Jiangxue looked at Feng Changqing quietly for a few times.
Feng Changqing had a look of expectation on his face, but he was also very unwilling in his heart.
He hoped that Chu Jiangxue could forgive him and leave him a way to survive.
At the same time, he is a top god, but his life and death are now decided by his daughter's words. This makes him very unwilling and feels very humiliated.
"Mo Fan, Feng Changqing was once my father, but he not only imprisoned me, but also placed a restriction on my Dantian to prevent me from self-destructing. Since then, I have severed the father-daughter relationship with him. Now I am a stranger with him. It is up to you to decide whether he lives or dies." Chu Jiangxue said lightly.
When she was in Piaomiao Shrine, in order to refuse to be taken away by Tan Yi, she once blew herself up to beg Feng Changqing to let her go.
But Tan Yi told her that Feng Changqing secretly placed a restriction on her Dantian, so she couldn't blow herself up even if she wanted to.
She could only be forcibly taken away alive by Tan Yi.
At that moment, her heart was filled with despair, and her hatred for Feng Changqing reached its peak.
What Feng Changqing did was not worthy of his father's status.
It was also at that time that she decided to completely sever the father-daughter relationship with Feng Changqing.
He now calls Feng Changqing, no longer father or father, but by his first name.
This is to draw a clear line with Feng Changqing.
Feng Changqing turned pale when he heard what Chu Jiangxue said.
"Jiangxue, I... I was wrong. I was coerced by Tan Luoyun in the past. If I didn't agree to him, Qinghong Sword Sect would break off relations with our Piaomiao Shrine and secretly suppress us. Qinghong Sword Sect is stronger than us, and if we are suppressed by them, our status in the divine domain will be greatly affected, so..." Feng Changqing begged cautiously, her voice trembling and dry.
Feng Changqing felt very embarrassed for a top god to beg forgiveness from others like this, and it was his own daughter.
But in order to survive, he had to endure it.
Chu Jiangxue sneered, "So, you can sacrifice your biological daughter for the Piaomiao Shrine?"
"Tan Yi...he also takes a liking to you. He will treat you well and won't treat you badly. If you become a Taoist partner with him, you will get more cultivation resources, which is not a bad thing for you." Feng Changqing defended.
"Haha, you won't treat me badly? Feng Changqing, do you know that Tan Yi just treats me as a plaything? He said that after he gets tired of playing with me for a few months, he will give me to Zhao Xunchuan. He also said that it is a great honor for me to be the plaything of Zhao Xunchuan, an ordinary Lord God. So, this is what you call being nice to me?"
"What? Tan Yi really said that?" Feng Changqing couldn't believe it.
He couldn't believe that Tan Yi had said such words and dared to treat Chu Jiangxue like this.
"Hmph! Tan Yi is dead. I don't need to say bad things about him. I'm just stating the facts. I feel dirty even if I say anything about such a scumbag. Besides, don't even think about begging me to let you go. It was you who didn't let me go at the beginning and didn't care about my life or death. Now I'm just treating him the way he wants."
Having said this, Chu Jiangxue no longer looked at Feng Changqing, but put her arm around Mo Fan and rested her head gently on Mo Fan's shoulder.
Mo Fan pondered for a moment and thought of a way.
"Feng Changqing, I will give you a chance. A chance to live." Mo Fan said.
Chu Jiangxue pulled Mo Fan's sleeve and whispered: "Mo Fan, you don't have to give me face. I just said that I have nothing to do with Feng Changqing. You can decide whether he lives or lives."
Mo Fan kissed Chu Jiangxue's forehead lightly, "Jiangxue, I am making this decision now not for your sake, but for our safety."
Mo Fan knew that although Chu Jiangxue no longer recognized Feng Changqing as her father, it was a bit cruel for her to ask her to ask Mo Fan to kill Feng Changqing.
Mo Fan gave Feng Changqing a chance now so as not to embarrass Chu Jiangxue.
